package org import ( "context" "github.com/vuka-lang/ui/v2" "github.com/vuka-lang/web/v2" ) // Layout frames an organisation's pages. It reads the request's query, // through a function of its package: it loads on every navigation. type Layout struct { Org int Children ui.Node tab string } func (l *Layout) Load(ctx context.Context) error { l.tab = tabOf(ctx) return nil } func tabOf(ctx context.Context) string { return web.Request(ctx).URL.Query().Get("tab") }
{Children}
